event_text: Per Ochsner, an unauthorized party accessed two employee user accounts and downloaded files from one
Ochsner says it learned of the data incident and secured the accounts
Ochsner says it determined that specific information was accessed
Ochsner begins notifying people; a group called Vortex is listed as claiming Ochsner files, per press and a tracker
Louisiana outlets report the notice and the Vortex claim; Ochsner opens a help line
Our check: no count of affected people, no named attacker and no method published
